decisions.reason: The multi-model illuminated candle arch line sits close to the core Erzgebirge-style offer and was promoted on the home page, so management keeps it despite the lack of recent visibility.
The one-tier pyramid fits the traditional seasonal range the firm is known for and costs little to keep in the assortment, so management keeps it.

As the publicly announced flagship line with several models and substantial investment, management persists with the electronic music box and attributes weak results to pandemic-era disruptions rather than to the concept.

Although only mentioned on the website and similar to the already withdrawn platform D, the Christmas motif platform supports the committed flagship music box system, so management retains it as a complementary accessory.
